ambient_events: The wheel goes, and stops, and goes again.
A piece comes off the wheel and is set down on the board without being looked at.
The kiln ticks as it cools, all the way down the scale.
description: A domed brick kiln with a stack, blackened at the mouth and mended in three colours of brick, and a drying yard beside it under netting. Everything the Thornwarren eats off, drinks out of and stores in was made here.
name: The Kiln
